segments.name: Alibaba China E-commerce Group
segments.description: Runs Chinese online retail marketplaces, quick commerce and wholesale platforms for consumers, merchants and brands.
segments.evidence: Alibaba China E-commerce Group, which includes Taobao, Tmall, Quick commerce, Xianyu, 1688.com and other businesses.

segments.name: Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group
segments.description: Operates international retail and wholesale commerce platforms for overseas consumers, merchants and businesses.
segments.evidence: Our revenue from customer management services is mainly contributed by AliExpress, Trendyol and Lazada.

segments.name: Cloud Intelligence Group
segments.description: Provides cloud computing and related services to enterprises and developers.
segments.evidence: Following this strategic re-alignment, for fiscal year 2026, our business segments are (1) Alibaba China E-Commerce Group, (2) Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, (3) Cloud Intelligence Group and (4) All others.

segments.name: All others
products: Hujing Digital Media and Entertainment Group
segments.description: Holds retail, logistics, healthcare, media, mapping, AI assistant, gaming and collaboration businesses serving consumers and enterprises.
segments.evidence: All others, which includes Freshippo, Cainiao, Alibaba Health, Hujing Digital Media and Entertainment Group, Amap, Qwen Consumer Business Group, Lingxi Games, DingTalk and other businesses.

revenueModel.text: Merchants and brands pay for customer management, commissions, logistics and cloud services, while consumers pay for goods and delivery.
revenueModel.evidence: We leverage our leading technologies to provide various value propositions to participants in our ecosystem and monetize by offering different services and creating value under each of our business segments.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2026 the company combined Taobao and Tmall Group, Ele.me and Fliggy into Alibaba China E-commerce Group.
changes.evidence: to advance our "user first" strategy and enhance user experience, we undertook a strategic combination of Taobao and Tmall Group, Ele.me and Fliggy into Alibaba China E-commerce Group.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2026 the company reclassified Cainiao, Amap and Hujing Digital Media and Entertainment Group into All others.
changes.evidence: We simplified the financial reporting structure by reclassifying Cainiao, Amap and Hujing Digital Media and Entertainment Group into "All others".

changes.text: In fiscal year 2025 the company sold Sun Art and Intime.
changes.evidence: In fiscal year 2025, the sale of Sun Art was completed and the sale of Intime was substantially completed.
